description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Event flags of map0, Old Silent Hill at the start: the intro chase in the alley (map0_s00), the cafe and the first Air Screamer (map0_s01) and the bonus areas (map0_s02): cutscenes, music layers, pickups.

M0S00_OpeningCutsceneSeen.description: Set when the opening cutscene of the fog streets starts (Harry walks into town, 'Cheryl. Where could you be?'). Blocks the tick event so the scene plays once.

M0S00_CherylFootstepsHeard.description: Set when Harry hears Cheryl's distant footsteps ('Footsteps?'): any of three trigger boxes or one button spot on the first street. Gates the FMV event that follows.

M0S00_CherylFmvSeen.description: Set after the FMV of the first street (file XA/M2_01190, played after the footsteps). Gates the 'Cheryl spotted' scene and adds music layer 1 of the street.

M0S00_CherylSpottedCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry spots Cheryl ('Cheryl? Is that Cheryl!?', 'Hey wait...stop!'). Starts Cheryl's run ahead, the alley camera and the wrong-way turn-back events.

M0S00_CherylLeadRunStarted.description: Set on the first frame of Cheryl's run ahead to (-62, 108) after she is spotted (her waypoint is set once).

M0S00_CherylLeadRunEnded.description: Set when Cheryl's first run ends (out of camera view or too far): she is parked off-screen; the next phase (she runs round the corner) starts.

M0S00_CherylRunsIntoAlleySeen.description: Set by the short scenes where Cheryl runs off towards the alley (trigger boxes at x -56/-57, z 108..126). Starts her corner run and blocks those scenes.

M0S00_AlleyCameraActive.description: Set together with M0S00_CherylRunsIntoAlleySeen: from then on the scripted camera of the street before the alley and of the alley door follows Harry.

M0S00_CherylCornerRunEnded.description: Set when Cheryl's run round the corner (z >= 49) ends out of view; then she waits at the alley door.

M0S00_CherylAtAlleyDoor.description: Set when Harry comes within 14.8 m of Cheryl waiting at the alley door (-61, 48): she starts running through it.

M0S00_CherylThroughAlleyDoor.description: Set when Cheryl has run through the alley door: the door sound plays and she leaves the scene. Ends the Cheryl chase.

M0S00_CherylStreetReached.description: Set silently when Harry reaches (-62, 90) on the street Cheryl ran down. Disables the three 'I'd better follow Cheryl...' turn-backs at the wrong-way spots and arms the turn-back at (-62, 100) for walking back north.

M0S00_AlleyEntered.description: Set when Harry opens the alley door at (-57, 47) (room load into the lit alley). Ends the Cheryl chase and starts the alley darkening with his progress.

M0S00_DeeperAlleyEntered.description: Set when Harry goes through the door at the end of the lit alley (-110, 224) into the deeper alley. Darkness jumps to 60 and the 'A dead end?' spot becomes active.

M0S00_AlleyNearlyDark.description: Set when the alley darkness reaches 80 of 100. Triggers the 'That's strange, it's getting darker.' scene; from then on the darkness keeps rising by itself.

M0S00_AlleyFullyDark.description: Set when the alley darkness reaches 100. Stops the darkness update, lets the 'getting darker' scene go on to the Grey Children, and arms the nightmare scene at the body on the fence.

M0S00_AlleyGetsDarkerCutsceneDone.description: Set near the end of the 'it's getting darker' scene ('......better than nothing, I guess.'). Starts the flickering light of the last alley and lets the three Grey Children spawn there.

M0S00_DeeperAlleyDarknessStarted.description: Set on the first update after entering the deeper alley: fog density 6, ambience volume lowered, darkness set to 60. One-shot guard.

M0S00_DeadEndSeen.description: Set by the 'A dead end? What the hell!?' scene at (-185, 227) in the deeper alley. Afterwards the spot shows a plain message instead.

M0S00_LastAlleyMusicStep1.description: Set silently at (-261, 245), the first trigger box on the way from the deeper alley door to the body on the fence. Adds music layer 2. It is cleared when Harry dies in the alley (music goes silent).

M0S00_LastAlleyMusicStep2.description: Set silently at (-259, 237) on the way to the body on the fence. Adds music layer 5.

M0S00_LastAlleyMusicStep3.description: Set silently at (-258, 229) on the way to the body on the fence. Adds music layer 3.

M0S00_LastAlleyMusicStep4.description: Set silently at (-252, 228), next to the body on the fence. Adds music layer 4; with M0S00_LastAlleyMusicStep1 clear (after Harry's death) it silences the music instead.

M0S00_AlleyNightmareStarted.description: Set when the alley nightmare scene starts at the body on the fence (-252, 222) ('What is this?', then the Grey Children attack). Stops the wheelchair wheel and its squeak, adds music layer 6, enables the message at map point 38.

M0S00_HarryDiedInNightmare.description: Set when Harry's dying animation in the alley nightmare reaches its end (only on map0_s00 the death does not lead to game over). Triggers the after-death reset.

M0S00_NightmareOver.description: Set when the after-death reset of the alley starts; the next tick event loads the cafe (map0_s01), where Harry wakes up.

M0S01_PickupKitchenKnife.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the kitchen knife on map0_s01 (Old Silent Hill - cafe) at map point 1 (x 5.1, z 274.1 m), event 10; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S01_PickupFlashlight.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the flashlight on map0_s01 (Old Silent Hill - cafe) at map point 2 (x 5.0, z 267.3 m), event 11; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S01_PickupPocketRadio.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the pocket radio on map0_s01 (Old Silent Hill - cafe) at map point 4 (x 2.3, z 273.9 m), event 13; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S01_PickupMap.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the map on map0_s01 (Old Silent Hill - cafe) at map point 3 (x 5.0, z 267.3 m), event 12; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S01_FmvStarted.description: Set by the first event of the cafe (map0_s01): the intro movie that plays when a new game starts. It allows the cafe cutscene with Cybil (event 3) to run next and is read by the map music mix in map0_s01 hooks.lua.

M0S01_CafeCutsceneStarted.description: Set when the cafe cutscene with Cybil (map0_s01 event 3, Harry wakes up and gets the handgun) is triggered after the intro movie. While it is set and the Air Screamer fight has not started, the cafe loads the Air Screamer for its fly-by past the window once the town map is taken.

M0S01_AirScreamerFlybyStarted.description: After the town map is taken from the cafe counter: set when Harry moves or 7.5 s pass, which starts the Air Screamer's fly-by past the window.

M0S01_AirScreamerFlybyDone.description: Set when the Air Screamer fly-by ends (25 s of its track, or Harry walks 0.7 m away), or at once when the bird is not loaded (save made after the pickup). The bird is parked off-screen.

M0S01_PickedUpKnifeAndMap.description: Kept up to date every frame in the cafe (map0_s01): true while both the kitchen knife and the town map have been picked up. It arms the Air Screamer intro cutscene (event 4) at the cafe exit.

M0S01_AirScreamerIntroCutsceneStarted.description: Set partway through the Air Screamer intro in the cafe (map0_s01 event 4, at the exit once knife and map are taken: the radio crackles and the creature crashes through the window). It swaps the cafe's world objects to their after-intro versions.

M0S01_AirScreamerIntroOutsideShotDone.description: Set at step 13 of the Air Screamer intro: the scene cuts back inside the cafe, so the cafe models switch from the outside view set back to the normal set.

M0S01_AirScreamerFightStarted.description: Set at the end of the Air Screamer intro when the bird smashes through the window and the fight begins. Shows the broken window/building models and glass, switches the fight music, and from then on its death is detected.

M0S01_AirScreamerDied.description: Set in the cafe (map0_s01) when the Air Screamer's health drops to zero during the fight. It switches the cafe music to the town theme, enables the pocket radio pickup and the after-fight scene (event 5), and changes the cafe exit message.

M0S01_CafeCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the cafe scene with Cybil (Harry wakes, gets the handgun). Enables the 'A radio...is it broken?' message at the radio and selects the cafe music. Cleared when the Air Screamer dies.

M0S01_AirScreamerEncounterActive.description: Set when the radio starts crackling at the start of the Air Screamer intro; cleared when the bird dies. While set, the radio and the cafe doors answer with 'I've got to beat that monster!' and similar messages.

M0S01_AirScreamerDeathPlayed.description: Set at the end of the short scene after the Air Screamer dies in the cafe (map0_s01 event 5): the radio static stops and Harry says "This is not a dream!". Nothing in the base game reads it later, so the scene plays once.

M0S01_RadioStaticPlaying.description: Set while the pocket radio's static and interference loops play from the cafe table (from the Air Screamer intro); cleared by the bird's death scream scene ('This is not a dream!').

M0S02_PickupKatana.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the katana on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 25 (x -140.9, z 62.1 m), event 10; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_UnlockedChannelingStone.description: Set by the results screen when the next game is prepared, if the first extra option is unlocked. It makes the Channeling Stone appear in the bonus area (map0_s02) and enables its pickup events.

M0S02_PickupGasolineTank.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the gasoline tank on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 23 (x -177.6, z 21.2 m), event 21; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_UnlockedGasolineTank.description: Always set by the results screen when it prepares a Next Fear game. It makes the gasoline tank appear in the bonus area (map0_s02) and enables its pickup; the gasoline is then used to fuel the chainsaw or the rock drill.

M0S02_PickupChannelingStone.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the channeling stone on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 27 (x -146.0, z 18.3 m), event 7; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S00_WheelchairSqueakStarted.description: Runtime sound guard of the opening alley: set once the wheelchair squeak loop has been started; cleared on map load and when the radio cuts the sound, so the loop restarts.

M0S01_HealthDrink0.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map0_s01 (Old Silent Hill - cafe) at map point 13 (x 5.1, z 273.7 m), event 0; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S01_HealthDrink1.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map0_s01 (Old Silent Hill - cafe) at map point 14 (x 4.9, z 267.5 m), event 1; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_FirstAidKit.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the first aid kit on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 29 (x -147.1, z 22.2 m), event 0; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_HealthDrink0.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 30 (x -141.7, z 21.0 m), event 1; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_HealthDrink1.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 31 (x -141.0, z 19.0 m), event 2; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_HealthDrink2.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 32 (x -137.8, z 18.6 m), event 3; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_HandgunBullets.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the handgun bullets on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 33 (x -182.9, z 19.5 m), event 4; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_HealthDrink3.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 34 (x -100.3, z 18.9 m), event 5; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M0S02_HealthDrink4.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map0_s02 (Old Silent Hill - bonus unlockable areas) at map point 35 (x -100.4, z 18.7 m), event 6; once set the pickup is gone for good.
